onset.Description: Onset of the event relative to the first scanner trigger pulse.

trial_type.Description: Type of event within the Card Guessing task.

Levels.card_decision: "?" is shown on screen: the participant guesses whether the upcoming card is higher or lower than 5.
Levels.feedback_win: An up arrow is shown which indicates a rewarded outcome.
Levels.feedback_loss: A down arrow is shown which indicates a non-rewarded outcome.
Levels.feedback_none: No arrow is shown because the participant did not make a valid response during the decision phase.

trial_num.Description: Sequential trial number within the Card Guessing task.

block_num.Description: Block number this trial belongs to.

block_type.Description: Type of Card Guessing reward-probability condition.

Levels.POS: High reward probability block: ~75% of trials in this block are predetermined to reward the participant.
Levels.NEG: Low-reward probability block: ~75% of trials in this block are predetermined to not reward the participant.

predetermined_outcome.Description: Predetermined outcome associated with the trial.

Levels.loss: Predetermined to not reward the participant.

response_time.Description: Participant response time for the card decision, measured from the onset of the card decision event to the participant response. Only populated on card_decision rows: n/a otherwise, and n/a if no valid response was made.

key_pressed.Description: Keyboard key pressed by the participant in response to the card decision. Only populated on card_decision rows: n/a otherwise.

Levels.lower: Participant guessed that the card would be lower than 5.
Levels.higher: Participant guessed that the card would be higher than 5.
Levels.n/a: No valid response was made during the decision window.
Levels.invalid_or_multipress(82.0): Participant pressed a key that did not correspond to a valid lower or higher response (raw key code 82).
Levels.invalid_or_multipress(71.0): Participant pressed a key that did not correspond to a valid lower or higher response (raw key code 71).
Levels.invalid_or_multipress(66.89): Participant pressed a key that did not correspond to a valid lower or higher response, a multipress key artifact (raw key code 66.89).

number_shown.Description: Number presented during the number reveal event. Only populated on number_reveal rows: n/a otherwise, and n/a if no valid response was made on the trial.
